This project demonstrates that sophisticated AI techniques can achieve strong performance on modest personal budgets, successfully scaling from simple games like Tic-Tac-Toe to complex strategy games like Chess. sources.title: GitHub - Robh96/AlphaZero-from-scratch: Implementation of Deepmind's ...
sources.snippet: This project implements a complete AlphaZero chess engine from scratch, demonstrating how reinforcement learning can achieve superhuman performance in complex strategy games without human knowledge. The implementation follows the original DeepMind AlphaZero methodology, combining deep neural networks with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for strategic planning and self-play training.
